question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V were seven kids sitting around a square table, facing the centre. Three of them were sitting at the corners while four others were sitting at the exact centre of the sides. One of the corners was empty. U, sitting at one of the centre of the sides, was second to the right of T. There was one empty chair between P and U. R and Q were diagonally opposite to each other. T was at the immediate left of Q. S was to the immediate left of V. Who among the following was the kid at a corner position?
